faq.title: Common questions
faq.priceQ: How much does an hour of private {topic} tuition cost?
faq.priceA: Prices start at ₪{min} an hour and go up to ₪{max}, depending on the tutor's experience and the level. Tutors set their own rates, and you can filter by the budget that suits you.
faq.onlineA: Yes. {online} of {total} tutors teach online over Zoom or Google Meet, so you can learn from anywhere in the country without travelling.
faq.chooseQ: How do I choose the right tutor?
faq.chooseA: Read reviews from previous students, check the tutor's qualifications and how many lessons they've given, and make sure they explain in the language you're comfortable with — Arabic, Hebrew or English. For in-person lessons, check whether they travel to you or you go to them.
faq.commissionQ: Is there a commission or fee on lessons?
faq.commissionA: Searching and contacting tutors is completely free for students. And for tutors — we take no commission on lessons they arrange themselves with a student. That's the core difference between us and the other platforms operating here.
faq.localityQ: Are there tutors who come to your home in {locality}?
faq.localityA: Yes, {inPerson} tutors teach in person in {locality} and neighbouring towns. You arrange with the tutor whether the lesson is at your place, theirs, or somewhere public.
faq.genderQ: Can I ask for a female tutor?
faq.genderA: Yes. There's a dedicated tutor-gender filter on the search page, so you can see only female or only male tutors — whatever suits the family.
faq.arabicQ: Do the tutors explain in Arabic?
faq.arabicA: Every tutor here speaks Arabic. Many also explain in Hebrew or English, and some specialise in explaining Hebrew-taught university courses in Arabic.

forTutors.title: Teach on Darsak — no commission on your lessons
forTutors.subtitle: An Arabic-language platform for private tutors in Israel. Build your profile, let students find you, and keep every shekel from lessons you arrange yourself.
forTutors.point1Body: A full tutor profile, with every subject and area you teach, at no cost.
forTutors.point2Body: Other platforms here take up to 20% of every lesson — even when the student paid you in cash. We don't. A lesson you arranged stays entirely yours.
forTutors.point3Body: We build a page for every subject and every town, so students find you on Google when they search for a tutor nearby.
forTutors.point4Body: Your profile, your conversations with students, and support — all in your language.

about.title: About
about.body: Darsak connects students with private tutors in Israel — in Arabic. We built it because every existing platform here is Hebrew-only, covers not a single Arab locality, and offers none of our subjects: no Arabic, no Hebrew as a second language, not even YAEL. All of that is missing for more than two million people.
